note: OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026. 'question' is a regex matched against the last user message of each logged request; 'poisoned' matches requests where a poisoned document was retrieved. 'success' says how a reply counts as the attack working. This is a keyword classification of requests from every tool, so treat the counts as an index into the log, not a verdict. Categories with no 'detect' rule have no automated test yet. 'tools' lists the tools whose prompts exercise a category (used by the scan page to choose what to run). 'docs' says which document set a category is tested on (default clean): LLM05 and LLM09 need the poisoned set. 'unless' lists phrases that mean the reply merely quotes the poisoned document, which is not counted as obeying it.
